qs.q: What is a Web Page?

c.x: A document written in the HTML language
A machine that hosts website files
A browser used to view the internet
A set of rules for communication

qs.e: A Web Page is a World Wide Web document written in HTML form, used to build a website.

qs.q: What is a Website?

c.x: A single HTML file in a browser
A collection of linked web pages
A software tool for writing code

qs.e: A Website is a collection of inter-linked web pages that contains text, graphics, and multimedia elements, stored on a web server.

qs.q: What is Hypertext?

c.x: Text that contains links to other texts
Text that is always written in bold
A language used to program servers
A common format used for images

qs.e: Hypertext is a text which contains links to other texts, and is therefore usually non-linear.

qs.q: What is a Protocol?

c.x: A browser used to view websites
A tag placed inside an HTML page
A template used to design pages

qs.e: A protocol is a set of rules that is used to communicate applications to each other, such as HTTP, TCP/IP, FTP, and E-mail.

qs.q: What is a Web Application?

c.x: A static file with no interaction
Web pages generated per user request
A device connected to the internet
A type of network address online

qs.e: A web application consists of a set of web pages that are generated in response to user requests, such as search engines and online stores.

qs.q: A page whose content stays exactly the same every time any user views it, and does not respond to user input, is best described as:
qs.e: A static web page is an HTML document that is the same each time it's viewed and does not change in response to user input.

qs.q: A page that contains server controls such as labels, text boxes, and buttons, and whose content is regenerated each time it is requested, is:
qs.e: Dynamic web pages are pages whose content is dynamically regenerated each time the page is requested, and they contain server controls that users interact with.

qs.q: If two different users view the same web page and both see identical content with no change over time, this page is:
qs.e: Everyone who views a static web page sees exactly the same content, since it doesn't change in response to user input.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the bgcolor attribute in the body tag?

c.x: To set the font size of text
To add a link to the page
To align text on the page

qs.e: The bgcolor attribute is used to add color to the background of the site, as in <body bgcolor="yellow">.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the background attribute in the body tag?

c.x: To show an image as background
To set the color of the text
To insert a break in a line
To underline a word or phrase

qs.e: The background attribute is used to add an image to the site's background, as in <body background="logo.gif">.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the ALIGN attribute when used with the paragraph tag?

c.x: To change the color of the text
To align the paragraph on the page
To start a brand new paragraph

qs.e: The ALIGN attribute is used to align the paragraph on the web page, with possible values CENTER, LEFT, and RIGHT.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the FACE attribute inside the Font tag?

c.x: To set the font of the text
To set the size of the text
To set the color of the text
To align the text on the page

qs.e: The FACE attribute of the Font tag is used to set the font of the text.

qs.q: Which tag would you use to make a word appear <><u>underlined</u>?
qs.e: The <u> element is used to underline text.

qs.q: Which tag would you use to make a word appear with a strikethrough?
qs.e: The <s> element (or <strike>) is used to display text with a strikethrough.

qs.q: Which tag would you use to display a number like 31st with the 'st' raised above the line?
qs.e: The <sup> element displays text as superscript, raised above the normal line, as in 31st.

qs.q: Which tag would you use to display the '2' in H2O below the normal line?
qs.e: The <sub> element displays text as subscript, lowered below the normal line, as in H2O.

qs.q: Which tag would you use to display text in a monospaced (typewriter-style) font?
qs.e: The <tt> element is used to display text in a monospaced font.

qs.q: Given the URL http://www.wrox.com/index.html, what does the part 'http' represent?
qs.e: In a URL, the part before '://' such as 'http' represents the scheme.

qs.q: Given the URL http://www.wrox.com/index.html, what does 'www.wrox.com' represent?
qs.e: In a URL, the part such as 'www.wrox.com' represents the host address.

qs.q: Given the URL http://www.wrox.com/index.html, what does '/index.html' represent?
qs.e: In a URL, the last part such as '/index.html' represents the file path.
